label.purpose: Form labels, navigation, and dense control text.

code.purpose: Code, aligned numerals, and technical measurements only.

shadows.name: control-xs
shadows.purpose: Subtle lift for bordered controls and buttons.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action: compact, warm-ink, and stable across loading states.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 32px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--tao-radius-md, 10px); background: var(--tao-primary, oklch(0.205 0.01 70)); color: var(--tao-primary-fg, oklch(0.985 0.004 70)); font: 600 14px/1.5714 var(--tao-font-family, system-ui); box-shadow: var(--tao-box-shadow-xs, 0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05)); transition: background .1s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--tao-primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--tao-primary-active); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--tao-control-outline); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet bordered action that retains the same geometry as primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 32px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--tao-color-border); border-radius: var(--tao-radius-md, 10px); background: transparent; color: var(--tao-color-text); font: 600 14px/1.5714 var(--tao-font-family, system-ui); box-shadow: var(--tao-box-shadow-xs); transition: background .1s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--tao-color-fill-tertiary); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--tao-color-fill-secondary); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--tao-control-outline); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Outlined Input
components.description: A transparent, host-friendly field with a visible native focus path.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--tao-color-text); font-family: var(--tao-font-family, system-ui); } .ds-field-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-input { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--tao-color-border); border-radius: var(--tao-radius-md, 10px); background: transparent; color: var(--tao-color-text); font: 400 14px/1.5714 var(--tao-font-family, system-ui); transition: border-color .2s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1), box-shadow .2s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--tao-color-text-base) 20%, var(--tao-color-bg-base)); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--tao-primary); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--tao-control-outline); outline: none; }

components.name: Solid Tag
components.description: A compact semantic marker; color communicates status without changing geometry.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 22px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: var(--tao-radius-sm, 8px); background: var(--tao-primary); color: var(--tao-primary-fg); font: 500 13px/1.4 var(--tao-font-family, system-ui); }

components.name: Tabs Navigation
components.description: Text-first local navigation with a restrained active indicator.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--tao-color-border-secondary); } .ds-tab { position: relative; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--tao-color-text-secondary); font: 500 13px/1.5 var(--tao-font-family, system-ui); } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--tao-color-text); } .ds-tab-active { color: var(--tao-color-text); } .ds-tab-active::after { position: absolute; right: 12px; bottom: -1px; left: 12px; height: 2px; background: var(--tao-primary); content: ""; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--tao-control-outline); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Elevated Popover
components.description: A white task surface separated by restrained border and popup elevation.
components.html:
Component contract

Semantic parts remain stable across releases.
components.css: .ds-popover { width: 260px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--tao-color-border); border-radius: var(--tao-radius-lg, 12px); background: var(--tao-color-bg-elevated, white); color: var(--tao-color-text); box-shadow: var(--tao-box-shadow-secondary); font: 400 14px/1.5714 var(--tao-font-family, system-ui); } .ds-popover strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-popover p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--tao-color-text-secondary); }

narrative.overview: 约束即自由。tao-ui 通过严格的 token 系统消除重复视觉决策，让 AI 和人类选择组件，而非反复选择颜色、间距与圆角。克制、有序、笃定；界面服务任务，不用装饰争夺注意力。
keyCharacteristics: 能用间距解决的不用线条
能用灰度解决的不用颜色
能用留白解决的不用装饰
一个 token 值只出现一次定义

rules.name: Token Truth
rules.body: src/theme/theme.css 是视觉数值的真值源；文档漂移时修文档。

rules.name: Flat by Default
rules.body: 默认表面不加阴影；只有浮层和交互状态使用深度。

dos: Do 从 Seed → Derived token 系统消费颜色、尺寸、圆角和间距。
Do 保留清晰键盘 focus、错误、禁用和 reduced-motion 状态。
Do 使用 typed Semantic DOM 定制组件内部部件。
donts: Don't 使用渐变文字、彩色粗侧边条或装饰性毛玻璃。
Don't 嵌套卡片或用阴影代替信息层级。
Don't 使用 bounce、elastic、全大写或 700 字重。
